\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor,tikz,graphicx}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,backgrounds,fit,shadows,shapes.geometric,shapes.symbols}
\definecolor{colA}{HTML}{A32638}

% tikz docs (inherit anchors); minor mods :)
\makeatletter
\pgfdeclareshape{document shape}{
\inheritsavedanchors[from=rectangle] % this is nearly a rectangle
\inheritanchorborder[from=rectangle]
\inheritanchor[from=rectangle]{center}
\inheritanchor[from=rectangle]{north}
\inheritanchor[from=rectangle]{south}
\inheritanchor[from=rectangle]{west}
\inheritanchor[from=rectangle]{east}
% ... and possibly more
\backgroundpath{% this is new
% store lower right in xa/ya and upper right in xb/yb
\southwest \pgf@xa=\pgf@x \pgf@ya=\pgf@y
\northeast \pgf@xb=\pgf@x \pgf@yb=\pgf@y
% compute corner of ‘‘flipped page’’
\pgf@xc=\pgf@xb \advance\pgf@xc by-5pt % this should be a parameter
\pgf@yc=\pgf@yb \advance\pgf@yc by-5pt
% construct main path
\pgfpathmoveto{\pgfpoint{\pgf@xa}{\pgf@ya}}
\pgfpathlineto{\pgfpoint{\pgf@xa}{\pgf@yb}}
\pgfpathlineto{\pgfpoint{\pgf@xc}{\pgf@yb}}
\pgfpathlineto{\pgfpoint{\pgf@xb}{\pgf@yc}}
\pgfpathlineto{\pgfpoint{\pgf@xb}{\pgf@ya}}
\pgfpathclose
% add little corner
\pgf@xc=\dimexpr\pgf@xc-1pt\relax
\pgfpathmoveto{\pgfpoint{\pgf@xc}{\pgf@yb}}
\pgf@yc=\dimexpr\pgf@yc-1pt\relax
\pgfpathlineto{\pgfpoint{\pgf@xc}{\pgf@yc}}
\pgf@xb=\dimexpr\pgf@xb+.5pt\relax
\pgfpathlineto{\pgfpoint{\pgf@xb}{\pgf@yc}}
\pgf@xc=\dimexpr\pgf@xc+1pt\relax
\pgfpathlineto{\pgfpoint{\pgf@xc}{\pgf@yc}}
}
}

\tikzset{
   every path/.append style={
      line cap=round,
      line join=round
   },
   ds/.style={
      drop shadow={shadow xshift=2pt, shadow yshift=-2pt, fill=black!10},
   },
   box/.style={
      draw, rounded corners=3pt,
      fill=white, align=center,
      inner sep=.75em,
      minimum height=3em,
      minimum width=2.25em
   },
   document/.style={
      box,
      rounded corners=1pt,
      document shape
   },
   cloudy/.style={
      box,shape=cloud,sharp corners,aspect=1.5,inner sep=.15em
   }
}

\newsavebox\GraphA
\begin{lrbox}{\GraphA}
\begin{tikzpicture}[dot/.style={fill=black,circle,minimum size=3mm}]
   \node[dot] (a) at (0,0) {};
   \node[dot] (b) at (1,-1) {};
   \node[dot,rectangle,minimum size=3.5mm] (c) at (-1,-1) {};
   \node[dot,shape=diamond] (d) at (0,-2) {};
   \node[dot] (e) at (1,-3) {};
   \draw[Kite-,dashed] (a) -- (b);
   \draw[Kite-] (a) -- (c);
   \draw[-Kite] (b) -- (d);
   \draw[Kite-] (c) -- (d);
   \draw[Kite-Kite] (e) -- (d);
   \draw[Kite-,dashed] (b) to[bend left] (e);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{lrbox}

\newsavebox\GraphB
\begin{lrbox}{\GraphB}
\begin{tikzpicture}[dot/.style={fill=black,circle,minimum size=3mm},g/.style={gray!30}]
   \node[dot] (a) at (0,0) {};
   \node[dot,g] (b) at (1,-1) {};
   \node[dot,rectangle,minimum size=3.5mm] (c) at (-1,-1) {};
   \node[dot,shape=diamond] (d) at (0,-2) {};
   \node[dot] (e) at (1,-3) {};
   \draw[Kite-,dashed,g] (a) -- (b);
   \draw[Kite-] (a) -- (c);
   \draw[-Kite,g] (b) -- (d);
   \draw[Kite-] (c) -- (d);
   \draw[Kite-Kite] (e) -- (d);
   \draw[Kite-,dashed,g] (b) to[bend left] (e);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{lrbox}

\newsavebox\RCode
\begin{lrbox}{\RCode}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\foreach[count=\i] \col/\letter/\length/\off in {
   black/A/1.5/0,
   black/A/2/0,
   gray/B/.75/0,
   black/A/1.25/1/1,
   gray/B/.5/0,
   gray/B/1/1,%
   black/A/1.5/0%
} {
   \draw[\col,line cap=round,line width=2mm,draw=gray!40] (.5*\off,-.3*\i) -- ++(\length,0);
   \node[\col,left=1.5mm] at(0,-.3*\i) {\small\bfseries\sffamily\letter};
}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{lrbox}
